title: 1RB---_1RC0RD_1RD1RA_1LE1RB_0LF0LE_1RF0RD: the halt can only be entered at an overflow, and no congruence blocks it
text: Lean proves that the machine halts iff some overflow phase of its phase map leaves the string as j ones under a counter of length j (halts_iff_lands). A search for a residue invariant that excludes this finds none: over 20,000 overflows every class mod 3, mod each q up to 1,500 and mod 2a for a up to 31 that the halt needs is met by the orbit, about as often as chance predicts.
